title: Materials
notes: 124 families across 12 categories, 292 tiers in total.

The sheet stores a tier's modifiers as its nine stat columns, non-zero entries only, and since TICKET-MAT-01 so does the app: `bonuses` is `{ statId, modifier }` keyed by stat **id**, not by a code in the flat formula space. The numbers are unchanged — only what they point at is now unambiguous — but this fragment needs stats.json loaded alongside it, since every modifier names a stat id from there.
Tier values are quoted in Copper, which Concept 16 marks as the likely base unit but does not confirm. If that turns out to be wrong, it is one field per level, not a re-import.
Tiers are not generated. The sheet writes all ten out by hand and several families skip or repeat numbers, so a generator would quietly rewrite the User's table.

Every one of the sheet's nine modifier columns targets an invested or resource stat, so nothing was dropped in the move to stat ids. APT is the ruleset's only derived stat and the sheet never modifies it — which is the rule TICKET-MAT-01 enforces: a derived stat's formula is its only source.
